name: Brilliant Low-Calorie Lager
facts: CREATED AND BREWED IN THE UK

HELLO SUNSHINE. Hoppy, light, crisp, Lowrise Lager bursts with tropical and stone fruit aromas, dry malt flavours, and firm bitterness. Brewed with New Zealand Nelson Sauvin hops and British lager malts, it’s low cal without compromise.
*Leading 4%+ lagers in the UK range from 125 to 150 calories per 330ml, averaging approx. 135 calories.
